purpose: Stable architectural invariants. Business thresholds live in versioned rules, not here.

invariants.text: One entity has one source of truth.
One external action has one canonical writer.
A business-action error may not disappear silently.
Repeating an operation must not create a duplicate effect.
A change for one client must not mutate another client.
A new rule version supersedes the old version explicitly; history is retained.
A task is not complete without evidence of the resulting state.
Production source mutations are globally serialized; two independent writers may not edit live source concurrently.
Guardian may repair runtime state but may not autonomously rewrite production source.
Every fixed production bug receives a permanent regression test.

policy.silent_exception_ceiling: The listed counts are debt ceilings, not targets. Any increase fails the architecture contract; reductions are always allowed.
